Case No.: DR-2020-07 Location: 865 E. Monrovia Place, Azusa, CA
APN: 8625-005-015
Applicant: Peter Carlson
The City of Azusa received an application for a Design Review to implement Phase I of the Dhammakaya International Meditation Center (DIMC) Specific Plan. The proposal also includes a minor modification to the DIMC Specific Plan wherein the proposed meditation hall square footage is being decreased to be smaller than originally planned. Instead of being built at approximately 69,179 square feet, the proposed meditation hall will be approximately 48,750 square feet. Additionally, the proposal includes a smaller roof deck, site improvements (new landscaping and parking lot), and new perimeter fencing.
This proposal includes the preparation of Addendum No. 2 to the DIMC Specific Plan EIR (State Clearinghouse No. 2014121060) to analyze the proposed minor modification to the DIMC Specific Plan.

2.
Case No.: Code Amendment No. 249 Location: City of Azusa
Applicant: City of Azusa
The City of Azusa is proposing a Code Amendment to introduce Section 88.42.240 of the Azusa Municipal Code (AMC) and amend Sections 88.22.065, 88.24.005, 88.26.005, and 88.70.020 of AMC to regulate tobacco and vaping shops.
This proposal is exempt from environmental review because the proposed action is not considered a “project,” per Section 15378 of the CEQA Guidelines.
